title: The Last Lamp
text: A small brass lamp burns on a stone with no one to tend it, its flame steady. All around it, just beyond its light, the dark presses in, thick and cold and listening. As long as it burns, the dark stays back.

options.label: Carry the little lamp, holding the dark at bay.

outcomes.text: The dark keeps its distance while you travel. You can feel it pacing just beyond the light.

options.label: Each Scion feeds it a memory so that it burns brighter.

outcomes.text: It flares higher. Each of you has lost something, though none can say what.

options.label: Put it out; whatever waits in the dark, you would rather face it now.

outcomes.text: The dark rushes in all at once. It has been waiting a very long time.
